label.explanation: Writes from template-svc to S3 in us-east-1 fail with 500 InternalError / 503 ServiceUnavailable (lines 167, 181, 187, 197, 199) until the SDK's retry quota is exhausted (line 185). These are server-side errors from the cloud provider — not a credential (403) or configuration problem — and nothing on our side changed. notification-svc's errors (lines 175, 201, 220, 225, 252, 262) and the api-gateway 500s (lines 174, 182, 186, 198, 209, 218, 223, 224, 248, 257, 261, 271) are symptoms. Red herrings: line 172 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 150 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 71 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full).
